text.en: Reviewers emphasize Garrett's expertise in working with dogs with challenging backgrounds, including rehomed rescues and breeds with high environmental reactivity. Clients note that whether managing an Australian Shepherd or a sensitive rescue, training programs instill calm confidence in the animals. Pet parents feel grateful for the tailored attention given to their dogs.

Owners consistently praise Clover Canine for delivering transformative behavioral results through multi-week board and train programs. Clients highlight that previously reactive, stubborn dogs returned home as polite, well-mannered companions who behave reliably in public settings. Reviewers report noticeable lasting improvements in obedience and everyday household manners.

Clients applaud trainer Garrett for his patience, in-depth knowledge, and attentive communication throughout the training process. Pet owners appreciate his structured approach when personal owner training has stalled and professional intervention is needed. Reviewers frequently describe him as a dedicated trainer who genuinely cares about each dog's long-term success.

q.en: Does Clover Canine offer board and train programs?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently mention enrolling their dogs in multi-week and month-long board and train immersion programs.

q.en: Can the training help dogs that are reactive to their surroundings?

a.en: Yes, reviewers specifically highlight substantial progress with reactive, stubborn, or frequently rehomed dogs after completing training.

q.en: What breeds has Clover Canine trained in recent reviews?

a.en: Recent client reviews mention successful training outcomes for Australian Shepherds, energetic rescues, and various companion breeds.

q.en: How do dogs behave in public after completing training?

a.en: Owners report that their dogs return as well-behaved companions who receive regular compliments when out in public spaces.
